confidence.reason: Kernel scan evidence is good for several MTK 3.18-era drivers, but the selected tree is a Huawei6750 donor tree, exact Meizu LCM evidence is absent, several components are reference imports only, and Wi-Fi/audio were not inventoried.

actions: Create a Meizu-specific DTS include or board DTS rather than silently reusing Huawei board nodes.
Map supplied I2C evidence: i2c0 ft5x0x 0x5d and tps65132 0x3e; i2c1 bma253 0x18, ltr578 0x53, st480 0x0c, bq24157 0x6a, aw3643 0x63; i2c3 mt6311 0x6b; i2c4 mt6605 0x28.
Add pinctrl, reset, enable, IRQ/eint, regulator, and clock properties only after stock DTS/LK evidence confirms them.
Check for address collisions and disabled donor nodes before enabling Meizu nodes.
Set CONFIG_CUSTOM_KERNEL_LCM to the exact Meizu LCM after source validation.
Enable existing local Kconfig entries for ft5x0x, bma253, st480, imx278, bq24157, mt6311, mt6605, and sunwave.
Enable imported exact Kconfig entries for ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd, ltr578, ov8856jsl, and aw3643 after import.
Remove or leave unselected unrelated donor LCM selections that conflict with the Meizu panel.
Use local Kconfig symbol names discovered from the tree; do not invent config symbols.
Import or validate exact ili9881p_hd_dsi_txd source.
Register the LCM_DRIVER extern and table entry according to this tree's mt65xx_lcm_list convention.
Verify tps65132 bias handling inside the exact LCM source or associated helper.
Verify DSI lane count, video/command mode, timings, reset sequence, ID read, and backlight path against stock.
Reuse existing ft5x0x driver if compatible with stock firmware and input protocol.
Bind i2c0 reg 0x5d in DTS.
Port reset/eint/pinctrl and firmware selection from stock evidence.
Reuse existing BMA253 and ST480 sources after DTS/config verification.
Import exact LTR578 source or prove LTR559 reference compatibility before enabling.
Set sensor orientation/layout from stock, not donor defaults.
Verify factory nodes and calibration ABI expected by ROM userspace.
Reuse existing IMX278 source after table and power sequence verification.
Import or validate exact OV8856JSL driver, OTP, and sensor-list name.
Port camera power rails, MCLK, reset, power-down, and sensor order from stock.
Check camera HAL expects the same main/sub sensor names.
Import exact AW3643 implementation or validate AW3644 reference at register-map level.
Bind i2c1 reg 0x63.
Register the flashlight name/table expected by the camera stack.
Verify torch and flash current limits against stock.
Reuse bq24157 only if charger path is selected by config and board data.
Verify mt6311 i2c3 0x6b init and voltage assumptions.
Treat tps65132 as display bias tied to LCM unless stock shows a standalone regulator node.
Port battery meter, JEITA, thermistor, and charge-current tables from stock.
Reuse existing mt6605 source after Kconfig/Makefile/DTS verification.
Bind i2c4 reg 0x28.
Port VEN, IRQ/eint, clock, regulator, and firmware properties from stock.
Reuse existing sunwave source only after confirming transport and GPIOs.
Add DTS pinctrl/reset/irq/power properties from stock.
Verify char device, input node, and ioctl ABI match ROM fingerprint HAL.
Do not declare adaptation complete until Wi-Fi/BT/FM/GPS combo and audio route evidence is collected.
Inventory stock firmware names, WMT/CONN chip ID, audio codec, external amp if any, headset detect, receiver/speaker GPIOs, and mixer controls.
Only then decide whether existing donor drivers are usable.

summary.planning_result: Proceed as an MTK 3.18 board adaptation, not as a donor Huawei board reuse. The scan shows useful MT6755/MT6750-era drivers, but four named components are only partial/reference matches and must be validated or imported before declaring hardware coverage complete.
summary.policy: Treat stock/DeviceInfoHW names as evidence only. Confirm against stock DTS, LK logs, boot logs, and selected kernel registration tables before enabling each component.
